paragraphs.source_en: This dual nature of returns is clearly reflected when we look at stock market returns over the decades (Exhibit 2.2). Putting my own numbers to Keynes’s idea, I divide stock market returns into two parts: (1) *investment return* (enterprise), consisting of the initial dividend yield on stocks plus their subsequent earnings growth (together, they form the essence of what we call “intrinsic value”), and (2) *speculative return*, the impact of changing price/earnings multiples on stock prices.
